chunks: And in the narration of Zur‘ah, from Samā‘ah, he said:

I asked him about a man who divorced his wife while he was ill, so he said: “She inherits from him so long as she remains in her waiting period. If he divorced her in a state of causing harm, then she inherits from him up to one year. And if there remains in her waiting period, beyond the year, even a single day, she does not inherit from him.”

key_terms.تَرِثُهُ: she inherits from him; her entitlement to inheritance from the husband
key_terms.سَنَةٍ: one year; the maximum period mentioned for inheritance in the harmful divorce case
key_terms.طَلَّقَ: divorced; the act of issuing divorce
key_terms.عِدَّتِهَا: her waiting period after divorce, during which certain legal rulings remain in effect
key_terms.مَرِيضٌ: ill; describing the husband's condition at the time of divorce
key_terms.ٱلْإِضْرَارِ: causing harm; a harmful or injurious intent in the divorce

ai.seo_question: Does a woman inherit from a husband who divorced her while he was ill?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about the inheritance of a wife divorced by a sick husband. She inherits during her 'iddah, and if the divorce was done harmfully, her right extends up to one year; if the 'iddah goes even one day beyond that year, she does not inherit.
